verdict.rationale: LibreChat is a self-hosted web app that runs via Docker, npm, or Helm on your own machine. Its librechat.yaml custom endpoints explicitly name Ollama and support any OpenAI API-compatible service, which covers the core of running on local models. A 2023 community critique said local-model support got little effort and pointed to a LiteLLM proxy, but that is opinion rather than a concrete failure, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: llama.cpp, LM Studio and vLLM are not named in the evidence (only implied via OpenAI-compatible endpoints), no explicit documentation that the full stack works with no cloud dependency, and no hands-on corroboration of a fully local setup.
